source: OSRS Wiki: the pages "Free-to-play/Pay-to-play <Skill> training" (checked 2026-10-03) and the "Training plan" tables of this guide. The speed (xph) is a wiki guideline and depends on your level, inventory and axe/pickaxe; it is not part of the time calculations: time is computed only from the player's own measurements. XP per action (xpa) are exact in-game values.

methods.name: Regular trees
methods.where: Anywhere ordinary trees grow (for example by Lumbridge Castle)

methods.name: Oak trees
methods.where: By the Draynor bank, west of the Varrock bank, Port Sarim, Rimmington

methods.name: Willow trees
methods.where: Port Sarim: willow trees east of the Rusty Anchor Inn
methods.note: Use the nearby dock deposit box for useful logs, or drop unwanted logs. The arrow marks the Port Sarim area; look east of the inn for Willow trees. Draynor is an alternative near a bank, but dark wizards there can attack low-level players. Rates depend on your axe, level and competition.

methods.name: Yew trees
methods.where: South of the Edgeville bank: two yew trees close to the bank
methods.note: Slower XP than willows; the guide uses yews for the money the logs fetch. Other free yews stand behind Varrock Palace and south of the Falador east bank.

methods.name: Oak trees at Seers' Village or Hosidius
methods.note: The wiki's best up to level 35 with membership; willows work too.

methods.name: Teak trees
methods.where: Ape Atoll, Fossil Island, Isle of Souls, Prifddinas
methods.note: The lower bound is plain chopping, the upper is fast tick-manipulation methods with teaks: they demand attention.

methods.name: Shrimp and anchovies with a net
methods.where: Al Kharid, Draynor Village, the swamp by Lumbridge
methods.note: You can drop the fish (Shift + click) and not go to the bank.

methods.name: Sardines and herring for bait
methods.where: The same places as with a net

methods.name: Trout and salmon with fly fishing
methods.where: Barbarian Village, the river by Lumbridge
methods.note: Trout gives 50 XP, salmon 70. You need a lot of feathers (Feather): about 600 for levels 20-40.

methods.name: Lobsters in pots
methods.where: Musa Point on Karamja (the passage is 30 coins)

methods.name: Tuna and swordfish with a harpoon
Copper and tin
methods.where: The swamp south-east of Lumbridge, the Dwarven Mine
methods.note: Mine copper or tin until Mining 15. Keep ore you need for Smithing; drop only unwanted ore. A usable pickaxe can stay in your bag.

methods.name: Iron, dropping the ore
methods.where: South-east Varrock mine; use the iron rocks.
methods.note: Drop unwanted ore for XP or bank it if you need the materials. Use a pickaxe your Mining level allows; it can stay in your bag. This default avoids the aggressive scorpions in Al Kharid mine.

methods.name: The gnome course or the Draynor rooftops
methods.note: There are no falls on the gnome course and no food is needed.

methods.name: The Al Kharid rooftops
methods.note: Falls are possible; Marks of Grace drop.

methods.name: The Canifis rooftops
methods.note: Low XP, but the most Marks of Grace for the level: the course for the Graceful set.

methods.name: The Falador rooftops
methods.note: Marks of Grace drop; falls are possible.

methods.name: The Seers' Village rooftops
methods.note: Faster with Camelot Teleport set to the course (the hard Kandarin diary).

methods.name: The Pollnivneach rooftops
methods.note: The hard Desert diary raises the pace.

methods.name: The Rellekka rooftops
methods.note: The hard Fremennik diary raises the pace.

methods.name: The Ardougne rooftops
methods.note: Marks of Grace pile up on one tile and do not vanish while you run.

methods.name: Raw beef and chicken
methods.where: The permanent fire west of the Barbarian Village fishing spots
methods.note: Withdraw owned raw meat first; 26 pieces is one starter bag, not the whole goal. The existing fire needs no logs or tinderbox. Burnt food gives no XP; buying refills needs confirmed coins.

methods.name: Trout
methods.where: The permanent fire west of the Barbarian Village fishing spots
methods.note: Use banked raw trout first; 26 is one starter bag. Recheck supplies after each batch; burnt fish gives no XP. Buying refills needs confirmed coins.

methods.name: Tuna
methods.where: The permanent fire west of the Barbarian Village fishing spots; withdraw raw tuna first
methods.note: Use owned raw tuna first; 26 is one starter bag, not a whole-goal quantity. Burnt fish gives no XP. Buying refills needs confirmed coins.

methods.name: Wine (a jug with grapes)
methods.where: At Edgeville Bank; no range or guild access is needed
methods.note: Combine 13 grapes with 13 jugs of water per starter bag. Withdraw owned ingredients first. Wait 12 seconds after the batch for fermentation and XP. Below Cooking 68, bad wine gives no XP; recheck your level and budget before another batch.

methods.name: Regular logs
methods.where: Next to a bank (for example by the Grand Exchange)

methods.name: Bronze axes, scimitars and warhammers
methods.where: The anvil by the west Varrock bank
methods.note: Bronze axes (1 bar, 12.5 XP) to 5, scimitars (2 bars, 25 XP) to 9, warhammers (3 bars, 37.5 XP) to 18; then bronze platebodies.

methods.name: Bronze platebodies
methods.where: The anvil by the west Varrock bank

methods.name: Iron platebodies
methods.where: The anvil by the west Varrock bank

methods.name: Steel platebodies
methods.where: The anvil by the west Varrock bank

methods.name: Mithril platebodies
methods.where: The anvil by the west Varrock bank
methods.note: Five mithril bars a platebody.

methods.name: Adamant platebodies
methods.where: The anvil by the west Varrock bank
methods.note: Five adamantite bars a platebody. A dwarven stout boosts 87 to 88; the guide's last step is rune platebodies at 99 (98 boosted).

methods.name: Leather gloves and boots
methods.where: By a bank (leather from Al Kharid)

methods.name: Gold jewellery
methods.where: The Edgeville or Al Kharid furnace
methods.note: The wiki says it pays off; calculate by Grand Exchange prices.

methods.name: Cutting gems (sapphires from 20, emeralds from 27, rubies from 34)
Cutting diamonds
methods.note: The guide's fastest free Crafting from 43; every cut loses money at exchange prices, so check the budget first.

methods.name: Strike spells on cows and chickens
methods.note: Use the spell named by the plan and select its autocast setting if your staff supports it; otherwise cast manually. A confirmed owned elemental staff must be equipped to replace its rune type. Higher Strikes are selected only when at least 20 casts are already supplied; otherwise Wind Strike is the budget fallback. Refill a low rune supply with a starter batch of 100 casts. Remove metal armour and verify that damage and Magic XP are arriving. Bring the listed starter food, eat before health is low and bank when supplies run out. This is not a whole-goal budget, guaranteed profit or measured fastest method; confirmed completed sales alone fund purchases.

methods.name: Splash: spells on weak monsters
methods.note: Manual alternative only until the worn Magic attack bonus and location are verified. Bring runes for the chosen spell; monitor actual XP and do not assume zero damage from ordinary combat equipment.
methods.manualSetup: Verify Magic attack -64 or lower and a location outside the Lumbridge no-XP area.

methods.name: Enchanting sapphire amulets (then emerald from 27, ruby from 49)
methods.note: Lvl-1 Enchant turns a sapphire amulet into an Amulet of magic; a Staff of water replaces the water runes. Lvl-2 Enchant (27) takes emerald amulets and air runes, Lvl-3 (49) ruby amulets and fire runes. The margin moves with the market: check both prices before buying a batch.
methods.manualSetup: Check the amulet and the Amulet of magic prices first: the margin moves with the market.

methods.name: Low Level Alchemy
methods.manualSetup: Choose expendable target items and verify all rune costs and actual coin margin first.

methods.name: Superheat Item (iron ore)
methods.note: Starter batch: 25 unnoted iron ore, 25 nature runes and 100 fire runes, or equip an owned Staff of fire instead of the fire runes. Bank surplus items to leave 25 ore slots plus rune stacks. Keep coal in the bank to make iron bars. Cast manually on each ore, then bank the bars and refill. This is one starter bag, not the full-goal cost; rate and profit are not guaranteed.

methods.name: High Level Alchemy
methods.note: The loss or profit depends on the items: calculate by Grand Exchange prices.
methods.manualSetup: Choose expendable target items and verify all rune costs and actual coin margin first.

methods.name: Burying bones from combat
methods.where: Wherever you fight (bones from giant frogs, giants)
methods.note: Trained along with combat; the wiki says about 43k per hour with big bones.

methods.name: Camdozaal: fish offerings
methods.note: Fishing and Cooking also train along the way.

methods.name: Air runes
methods.where: The Air Altar south of Falador

methods.name: Earth runes
methods.where: The Earth Altar north-east of Varrock

methods.name: Fire runes
methods.where: The Fire Altar west of Emir's Arena

methods.name: Seagulls at Port Sarim
methods.where: Port Sarim docks: select the level 3 Seagulls
methods.note: Level 3 Seagulls cannot damage you; check the target level. Equip a compatible bow and arrow stack. Use Accurate while starting, then Rapid after Ranged 5. Pick up reusable arrows when safe; bank before ammunition runs out. The 100 arrows are a starter stack; the card above counts the whole goal.

methods.name: The monks of Edgeville Monastery
methods.note: Talk to a non-combat monk for free healing; leave combat before doing so. Equip the listed compatible bow and arrows; use Rapid after Ranged 5. Avoid Longrange if preserving Defence. Refill ammunition when low.

methods.name: Giant frogs
methods.note: Equip the compatible bow and arrows and use Rapid; avoid Longrange if preserving Defence. Ten food is a starter trip, not a guarantee for the goal. Bank while food or ammunition is low; do not wait until none remains.

methods.name: Flesh Crawlers
methods.where: Stronghold of Security, second level: Flesh Crawlers
methods.note: Requires Defence 40 in this recommendation. Check your ranged armour and food before entering; do not assume a ten-minute unattended window is safe. This is a starter trip; bank when food or ammunition is low. No verified method tile is available, so follow the written location rather than an old arrow.

methods.name: Moss giants from a safespot
methods.where: Varrock Sewers, the far end (or the south side of Crandor): Moss giants from a safespot
methods.note: The wiki's best free Ranged XP after Brutus. A knife or slash weapon cuts the web in the sewers; stand where they cannot reach you and pick up your arrows between kills. Big bones on every kill. This is a starter trip; bank when food or ammunition is low.

methods.name: Chickens and cows
methods.note: Bones and hides drop along the way.

methods.name: The monks of Edgeville Monastery
methods.note: Level 5 monks; talk to a non-combat monk for free healing, so no food is needed. They drop only bones.

methods.name: Al Kharid warriors
methods.where: The Al Kharid palace: level 9 warriors
methods.note: When you attack one, the others nearby join in: pull one aside first. The Al Kharid bank is just west of the palace.

methods.name: Barbarians
methods.note: None attack first. Bank in Edgeville, north along the road.

methods.name: Brutus
methods.where: Brutus's pen in the cow field east of Lumbridge
methods.note: Double combat XP. Step aside when he winds up a charge or a stomp: they hit up to 19. He comes back about 22 seconds after each kill.

methods.name: Minotaurs
methods.where: Stronghold of Security, floor 1 (the Vault of War): the level 12 Minotaurs
methods.note: The entrance is in the Barbarian Village mine; there is no bank on the floor, so bank in Edgeville first.

methods.name: Giant frogs
methods.note: Every kill drops Big bones: sell them or bury them for Prayer. They hit at most 2, so food is optional; an axe and a tinderbox let you cook on the spot. The swamp can be crowded.

methods.name: Hill Giants
methods.note: Big bones on every kill, plus limpwurt roots and runes. Bring food that heals well; a Brass key saves the walk past the skeletons. Very crowded at busy hours.

methods.name: Moss giants
methods.note: Big bones, runes and items to alch. Bring a slash weapon for the webs in the sewers and food: they hit hard on low Defence, and the bank is far.

methods.name: Lesser demons
methods.where: Karamja Volcano dungeon (or Crandor): Lesser demons
methods.note: They hit up to 8; bring swordfish or better. Fire runes and vile ashes drop.

methods.name: Gemstone Crab (Tlati Rainforest)
methods.note: No food is needed: the crab has "endless" health.

methods.name: Fruit stalls in Hosidius
methods.where: Hosidius, Great Kourend: the house by the beach with two stalls side by side
methods.note: Drop the fruit as you go; strange fruit restores run energy.

methods.name: Pickpocketing Ardougne knights
methods.note: Wear a Dodgy necklace and bring food; the medium Ardougne diary adds 10% success. Open the coin pouches before they fill.

methods.name: Maple bows
methods.note: Cut maple logs into unstrung longbows (shortbows first where the longbow is not open yet); stringing them is faster XP for more clicks.

methods.name: Yew bows
methods.note: Cut yew logs into unstrung longbows (shortbows first where the longbow is not open yet); stringing them is faster XP for more clicks.

methods.name: Magic bows
methods.note: Cut magic logs into unstrung longbows (shortbows first where the longbow is not open yet); stringing them is faster XP for more clicks. Magic shortbows (80) lose a little; magic longbows (85) pay.

methods.name: The quests Jungle Potion, Recruitment Drive and The Dig Site
Brewing potions (Attack, Antipoison, Defence, Prayer, Super attack)
methods.note: The speed grows with the potion tier; so does the cost.

methods.name: High potions (Super restore, Saradomin brew, Super combat)
methods.note: Super restores from 63, Zamorak brews from 78, Saradomin brews from 81, Super combat potions from 90; the cheaper potion of a level band is often the better buy. Mastering Mixology (Children of the Sun) is the calm alternative from 60.

methods.name: Allotments
methods.where: The patches at Falador, Catherby, Ardougne, Port Phasmatys
methods.note: It grows in real time: you plant and come back.

methods.name: Tree and fruit tree runs
methods.where: Tree patches at Lumbridge, Varrock, Falador and Taverley; fruit trees at the Tree Gnome Stronghold, Catherby and Brimhaven
methods.note: Oaks from 15, willows from 30, apple trees from 27 and banana trees from 33; pay the gardener to protect them. A tree run every few hours is most of the Farming XP; herb runs add money.

methods.name: Tithe Farm
methods.note: The wiki's figures are for level 74+; at 34 it is noticeably slower.
